desc:
🎂 Be born. Grow up. Live ANY life you want! 🎂

RoLife is a life simulator where every choice is yours. Start as a baby, age up year by year, and decide who you become!

⭐ GET FAMOUS: grow your followers, go on talk shows, sign brand deals and go on a world tour
💼 80+ CAREERS: teacher, chef, astronaut, surgeon, pop star and more
🏛️ POLITICS: start on the city council and climb all the way to President
🏢 BUSINESS: open a food truck, then build an empire
❤️ PEOPLE: make friends, fall in love and start a family
🏠 SPEND IT: houses, cars, boats and private jets
🎓 SCHOOL: study hard, pick a major and graduate
🔒 PRISON: get caught... then try to escape!
⚡ GOD MODE: design your own life from scratch

Every year brings surprise events and big decisions. Will you be a billionaire, a superstar or a legend?

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite for new updates!
